method: Full source inspection of entrypoints, recipes and shared instructions; structural validation and deterministic fixture replay. No independent model benchmark.

criteria: Distinct discovery trigger and correct domain owner
Relevant procedure and observable expected result
Inspection/implementation authority consistent with user intent
Shared guidance loaded once; conditional references only when needed
Stable skill names, workflow IDs, links and both host formats

context_size.bundle_definition: Entrypoint + selected recipe + working contract + direct shared domain references. Before includes mandatory host integration; after host detail is conditional.

checks.observed: Read every entrypoint and recipe, reviewing repeated identical paragraphs together. Corrected explicit-target probe contradictions, mandatory artifacts/phase counts, missing check setup, cross-domain assumptions and duplicated generic result contracts. Retained stable names/IDs, technical checks and versioned external references.
checks.limits: Source-level judgment; not an independent or exhaustive model execution of all 241 workflows.

checks.observed: Plugin validation passes for 46 skills and 241 recipes. Eleven static-site tests pass for all 257 canonical pages and eight Node search tests pass. Generated catalogs remain multilingual with both invocation namespaces.
checks.limits: Structural/output validation does not establish every model/provider runtime or search-engine visibility.

checks.observed: skill-creator quick_validate.py passed for all 46 skill folders.
checks.limits: Checks frontmatter/scaffolding consistency, not instruction behavior.

checks.observed: Official registry package @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.278 on darwin-arm64 validated the root marketplace, root plugin and packaged plugin with --strict; all three passed in isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
checks.limits: Manifest compatibility only; no paid Claude account, model task or Cowork execution used.

checks.observed: review/run_runtime_checks.py passed: 34 actual loopback HTTP cases with zero external requests/file writes; original serverless fixture rejected by regression checks, fixed reference passed all 3 Node tests.
checks.limits: Deterministic replay of known fixture code, not a new independent agent execution or provider guarantee.

checks.observed: 41 Python tests, 8 Node search tests and all 46 skill-creator validations pass. The exact 1.4.0 ZIP matches a second independent package build byte-for-byte; archive CRC, extracted package validation and Claude invocation search in all four languages pass.
checks.limits: Package/output checks and known runtime fixture replay; no claim of exhaustive independent model behavior.

limits: Historical model evaluations in 1.2.0/1.3.0 retain their original scope and fingerprints; they are not relabeled as new 1.4.0 model passes.
Context counts compare instruction text, not measured latency, model tokenization or quality scores.
Runtime fixture replay checks actual code/protocol invariants and is recorded separately; it does not certify every domain engine or host session.
